content.statement: The claim is supported because the current returns_policy_v2 explicitly sets a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, while the 14-day value is a stale v1 retrieval/judge reference.

evidence.test: deterministic policy-window comparison; RR/CI not computable because no raw event counts are present
